Solar pumps reach 10,000 Nalanda farmers

Solar-powered irrigation pumps have now reached 10,000 farmers in Nalanda district under the state's farm mechanisation push, officials said on Sunday.

The pumps, subsidised up to 80 per cent for small and marginal farmers, have cut diesel costs sharply in the pilot blocks.

Agriculture department data shows diesel use among beneficiary farmers fell by nearly two-thirds during the kharif season.

Farmer groups asked the government to extend servicing networks, reporting waiting periods of several weeks for minor repairs.

The department said 40 new service centres would open before the rabi season across the district.
